notes.title: v1.4.8
notes.content:
To celebrate the release of Operation STEEL on Switch here is a small patch to make the game a bit more  friendly for new players! Thanks everyone for your support!

[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Increase player health on Novice mode
[*] Changed boss/miniboss health pools a tiny bit (most have slightly less health now)
[/list]

notes.title: Switch Release and price change!
notes.content:
To coincide with Operation STEEL being released on Nintendo Switch, the Steam version's price is being reduced to match the Switch version!

The new price is $10 USD. Thanks to everyone who has supported me in the past!

notes.title: v1.4.6
notes.content:
Changelog:

A few fixes for high refresh-rate monitors (First miniboss in Planet X, particularly.)

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: Increased some UI text sizes for better visibility on small screens.

notes.title: v1.4.5
notes.content:
[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fix tutorial not resetting game mode

[*] Fix menu allowing multiple inputs in quick succession
[/list]

notes.title: v1.4.4 + Bonus goodies!
notes.content:
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Accessibility option for auto-shot. Now you do not have to hold the shot button, and but you can hold it to stop firing
[*] Accessibility menu is now closed if escape is pressed (bugfix)
[*] Seed is now always shown between levels
[*] Backshot buffed
[*] Big Phoenix miniboss health reduced again because everyone hates this guy
[/list]

[h2]Bonus![/h2]
Also another bonus to celebrate Shmup Fest... Operation STEEL now has Steam Community items available!
Hopefully you've now got some trading cards if you've played the game a bit. Badges, profile backgrounds and emojis are now available - including a special Bullet Heaven emoji kindly donated by Ed of
ːbullet_heavenːːbullet_heavenːːbullet_heavenː [url=https://www.youtube.com/@etrem88/videos]Bullet Heaven![/url] ːbullet_heavenːːbullet_heavenːːbullet_heavenː
Go get it in the Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1489300]points shop[/url]!

notes.title: Steam Shmup Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Steam Shmup Fest[/b] is upon us!

Not only is Operation STEEL going for a historic low price for this week, the fantastic Sophstar has joined the Indie Shmup Bundle:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30034/Indie_Shmup_Bundle/

The bundle discount has increased so you'll get even more bang for your buck too :)

Celebrate Shmup Fest by showing some indie devs some love!

notes.title: v1.4.3
notes.content:
[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Corgi no longer gets confused by volcanoes (Bug reported by [url=https://www.twitch.tv/drmoocowz]DrMooCowz[/url])
[/list]

notes.title: Indie Shmup Bundle + SteamDeck news
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce that Operation STEEL is no available in a bundle with two other awesome shmups released in 2022 as part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30034/Indie_Shmup_Bundle/]Indie Shmup Bundle[/url]!

If you don't have Dead End City or TerraFlame yet I highly recommend picking up the bundle and getting them at a discount :)

In other news, I have been trying to get Steam Deck Verified status for Op. STEEL - very close right now but there are still some in-game text that is too small (OK, there are a couple... but nothing that is important while playing the game.) I'll make another update if I take another pass and get the verification.

Thanks for reading!

notes.title: v1.4.2
notes.content:
[b]Changelog[/b]

Sorry, nothing too exciting today!

[list]
[*] Added ability to enter Seed without needing a keyboard
[*] Some minor text size increases for better readability
[/list]

notes.title: v1.4.1
notes.content:
[b]Changelog:[/b]

[list]
[*] Weapons are now always dropped in level 1 and not afterwards (still offered in shops though)
[*] Hard mode "item drop not spawning in level 1" modifier replaced with "faster enemy bullets"
[*] Hard mode enemy health increases significantly reduced (less Euro...)
[*] More points are awarded on hard mode per modifier added
[*] Flamerthrower has significantly larger range 
[*] Repairbot now heals either when the boss dies or at end of level (so you don't need to think about whether you need additional heal)
[*] Option no longer makes a firing sound
[*] Devastator fire rate and rocket speed increased
[*] Score/armour HUD fades out faster when moving over it
[/list]

notes.title: v1.4.0
notes.content:
Changelog:

[list]
[*]I've upgraded the engine to the latest version of Godot, hopefully some performance improvements might come through. If you see any weird new bugs that might have been caused by the update then please report them on Discord or the discussion board :)
[*]Slightly reduced later boss health (level 4 onwards)
[*]Slightly reduced miniboss health
[*]Slightly increased Dash and Flash item cooldowns
[*]Attempted to soften the coin SFX a touch
[/list]

notes.title: v1.2.0: Quality of Life Update!
notes.content:
[b]Balance updates, fixes and quality of life changes![/b]


Changelog:

[list]
[*]Start game in full-screen by default (on first run)
[*]Repair pickups spawn slightly more often
[*]Cobra ship starts with Bomb-bot in Novice mode (instead of Repair-bot)
[*]Bomb-bot now only triggers at 1 health remaining
[*]Repair-bot triggers at end of level, rather than beginning of level
[*]Buff 3-way weapon
[*]New Difficulty (Rank) graph to show dynamic difficulty
[*]Fix upgraded Flamer motion at level higher than 1
[*]Fix [REDACTED]'s final attack blocking some shots unintentionally
[/list]

notes.title: (Belated) Shmup Slam Sale!
notes.content:
Hi, I wanted to coincide a sale with the Shmup Slam 5 event but it was a tiny bit too close to my game's launch to be allowed... so here it is slightly late!

Shmup Slam is an event where a bunch of players play a bunch of shoot-em-ups live and commentated - you can check out the VODs on [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/TheElectricUnderground/videos]The Electric Underground's Youtube channel[/url]!

notes.title: Operation STEEL 1.0 Release!
notes.content:
It's happening!

This has been a passion project for me for the last few years, and my dream to create my first game for a lot longer. Now that dream has come true!

Thanks to everyone who has supported me on this journey. I hope you enjoy the game :)

notes.title: Demo v0.11 Update
notes.content:
Hi folks, one last demo version before the full game is released (I hope!)

Version  0.11 has a handful of small tweaks based on beta-testing feedback, including visibility updates, GUI changes and additions, and generally a bunch of nice-to haves and polish-ups.

Thanks for your continued interest!

 -Ben

notes.title: Demo 0.10d patch
notes.content: Just a small patch to fix some issues with high refresh rate monitors.

notes.title: Demo Version 0.10
notes.content:
A new demo version is here!
This should be the final version before the full game release... barring any bug fixes needed of course :)

Update highlights:
[list]
[*] Japanese localisation courtesy of @mojilove !
[*] A new item or two ;)
[*] New art for the forest level, shop and dialog UI
[*] Some new options, including vsync on/off (might still be a work in progress though, trying to optimise it if I can in future)
[*] Minor performance upgrades
[*] Maybe bugs related to the above... please tell me on Discord or Steam Discussions if you find anything :)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.09f
notes.content: Just a couple of bug fixes in here around control rebinding and display. Nothing exciting, sorry :)

notes.title: Version 0.09b
notes.content:
Version 0.09b is live.
It's a small update fixing a few bugs found in the Time Attack demo, also adjusted the Time Attack mode slightly which should result in a slightly higher score cap.

notes.title: New Time Attack mode!
notes.content:
In anticipation for Steam Next Fest, the Operation STEEL demo has been updated with a new [b]Time Attack mode[/b]!

Blast enemies as quick as you can in this new frantic mode, and see how high you can climb on the new leaderboard!
